articles.summary: Some of the chilliest air of the season is moving into North Carolina, bringing below-average temperatures and the potential for the season’s first widespread frost and freeze this weekend. With such a sudden change in the forecast, Duke Energy is sharing a few simple tips that can help customers save energy and money.
articles.title: Duke Energy shares simple energy- and money-saving tips as cold front moves into North Carolina

articles.summary: Duke Energy (NYSE: DUK) has posted its third-quarter 2026 financial results in a news release available on the company's website at the following link: duke-energy.com/investors.
articles.title: Duke Energy reports third-quarter 2026 financial results

articles.summary: Engineering students from the University of South Florida toured Duke Energy Florida’s Bartow Plant on Friday, meeting the employees who keep the power on for the company’s 2 million customers.
articles.title: Future engineers get an inside look at Duke Energy Florida’s Bartow Plant ahead of Power Plant Worker Appreciation Day

articles.summary: Duke Energy Florida customers will soon pay less for electricity following the Florida Public Service Commission’s (FPSC) approval of the company’s request to lower rates in 2027.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida customers to see lower rates in 2027

articles.summary: With a strong cold front is ushering in the coolest air of the season so far across Florida this weekend, Duke Energy is sharing a few simple tips that can help customers save energy and money.
articles.title: Duke Energy shares simple energy- and money-saving tips as cold front moves into Florida

articles.summary: With outdoor temperatures falling, Piedmont Natural Gas today announced it has decreased rates for its North Carolina customers. The latest rate change, which took effect Nov. 1, will lower the average residential customer bill by just under $12 per year.
articles.title: Piedmont Natural Gas lowers rates for North Carolina customers as winter heating season begins

articles.summary: With the National Weather Service calling for low temperatures near or below freezing in the Carolinas, Piedmont Natural Gas reminds customers about tips, resources and assistance programs to help customers manage their energy usage and costs during cold temperatures.
articles.title: Piedmont Natural Gas offers ways to manage energy usage and costs ahead of expected cold weather

articles.summary: Today, Duke Energy Florida filed plans with the Florida Public Service Commission to build four new solar energy sites by mid-2028. Together, these sites will add 300 megawatts (MW) of clean energy to the electric grid while delivering an estimated $1 billion in customer savings over their operational lifetimes.
articles.title: Duke Energy Florida plans 4 new solar energy sites to deliver $1B in customer savings

articles.summary: As outdoor temperatures fall and furnaces kick in, Duke Energy Ohio & Kentucky are reminding customers to know the signs of a natural gas leak and to take immediate action if they suspect one: If you smell natural gas, get out fast!
articles.title: Duke Energy Ohio & Kentucky share simple steps to recognize natural gas leaks as winter heating season begins

articles.summary: Duke Energy and the Duke Energy Foundation are providing more than $500,000 to support nearly 70 South Carolina organizations during the monthlong “Powering Plates. Nourishing Neighbors.” campaign, which raises awareness of food insecurity and spotlights the groups helping residents access nutritious food.
articles.title: Duke Energy launches annual monthlong campaign with more than $500,000 to spotlight food insecurity across South Carolina
